2026: contribution bases from Naredba NN 150/25 (757.34 / 11,958.00 EUR), MO I base reduction (ZOD čl. 21.a), personal allowance 600 EUR, local rates for all 556 local units from the Tax Administration's 2026 table.

employee.description: Code (šifra) of the city or municipality of residence from the tax card (porezna kartica), e.g. 1333 Zagreb, 4090 Split, 3735 Rijeka; selects the local income-tax rates (ZPD čl. 19.a)

Personal-allowance coefficient from the tax card, applied to 600 EUR (ZPD čl. 14): 1 basic; + 0.5 per dependent family member; children + 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.4, 1.9, 2.5, 3.2, 4.0, 4.9 …; disability + 0.3 (or + 1.0 at 100 %). 0 at an employer that does not hold the tax card
Whether the employee is a member of a mandatory pension fund (II. stup): then MO I is 15 % and MO II 5 %; otherwise MO I is 20 % (ZOD čl. 13, 17)
Whether the employee also has a salary from another employer this month; the MO I base reduction is then shared (ZOD čl. 21.a st. 5)
MO I base reduction in EUR this employer applies, from the employee's declaration or the Tax Administration's data (ZOD čl. 21.a st. 5); replaces the reduction computed from this employer's pay
Resident in a local unit of development group I or in Grad Vukovar: the income-tax advance is reduced by 50 % (ZPD čl. 24 st. 5)
First employment on a permanent contract (ZOD čl. 7 t. 54): no employer health contribution for up to one year (čl. 20 st. 2-3); set back to false when the year ends
Minimum contribution base in EUR replacing 757.34 — for part-time work (prorated by weekly hours, ZOD čl. 200 st. 2), partial months, or management-board members (0.65 x average wage)

contributionBases.description: Minimum and maximum monthly contribution base by the year the salary month belongs to (ZOD čl. 200, 204-205; Naredba čl. 3-4: NN 137/24 for 2025, NN 150/25 for 2026)

municipalTaxRates.description: Lower and higher income-tax rate by local-unit code (ZPD čl. 19.a; Porezna uprava 2026 table)

steps.message: Croatian salary is calculated per calendar month: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template
Pay is below the minimum contribution base in a partial month (or a month with unpaid or sick leave); the base is prorated by insured days (ZOD čl. 202), so set the employee's minimumContributionBase
The employee has another employer: the MO I base reduction is shared by the employee's declaration or the Tax Administration's data (ZOD čl. 21.a st. 5); set pensionBaseReduction

steps.label: Income tax advance (predujam poreza na dohodak)

limitations: Monthly salary for whole calendar months, paid in EUR in 2026. Income tax uses the rules in force on the payment date (ZPD čl. 24 st. 1); contributions use the bases of the year the salary month belongs to (2025 and 2026 held). A salary paid in 2027 needs the 2027 version.
The youth reduction (100 % up to age 25, 50 % from 26 to 30) is granted only in the annual tax calculation (ZPD čl. 46 st. 2), not in the monthly advance, so it is not applied here.

The employee's local unit, allowance coefficient and pension-fund membership come from the tax card and HZMO data and are entered per employee; development group I residence (50 % advance reduction) is entered per employee, not derived from the unit.
The minimum contribution base is prorated by FTE for part-time work; partial months below the minimum, and management-board members (0.65 x average wage), need an explicit minimumContributionBase.

Leave pay rules: pay kept for sick days is taken as the employer's naknada plaće for the first 42 days (7 for a disabled worker), paid from its own funds and taxed and insured as pay. From day 43 the employer pays on behalf of HZZO (70% of the base, 80% after six months, at most 995.45 EUR a month) and is refunded; that part's tax and contribution treatment was not confirmed from an official source and is treated as pay, and no statutory leave pay rule is declared because the monthly cap can't be expressed as a percentage of salary.

The MO I base reduction for several employers, or for a salary paid in several instalments, must be entered as pensionBaseReduction; the computed reduction assumes one employer and one payment, and is rounded to 0.01 EUR.

The annual pension ceiling (143,496.00 EUR) applied by the Tax Administration in the annual calculation, other contribution exemptions (e.g. employment of persons with disabilities) and increased-length insurance contributions (staž s povećanim trajanjem) are not modelled.
Non-taxable payments (e.g. bonuses within the non-taxable limits) must be excluded from taxable and social earnings by the tenant's pay components; pre-tax deductions are refused.
Amounts are rounded to 0.01 EUR, half up, per line.
Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the acts and the Tax Administration's rate table; the cases are derived from them, not from official worked examples.
